records.name: Code for Philly
records.summary: A volunteer nonprofit that uses technology, data and design to help the City of Philadelphia. Volunteers join project teams that build tools for the city.
records.what_you_do: Join a project team, or take on an organizing role.

first_step.how: Look at the Join a Project section of codeforphilly.org and contact a project team
first_step.basis: The site invites people to join projects and says no coding experience is needed

records.notes: The homepage text came back almost empty when fetched, so the description rests on a search summary of the same site and is not fully verified. A 2023 news story describes a Launchpad after a pause, but no recent dated evidence was found, so status is unknown. Not a platform lead; it came from the Meetup volunteering topic page.

records.name: Riverfront North Partnership
records.summary: The nonprofit that cares for 11 miles of riverfront parks and trails in Northeast Philadelphia. Volunteers clean up the greenway and report dumping or safety problems, and regular volunteers can earn Trailblazer status.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for a volunteer day, or do a solo cleanup on your own schedule and post about it.

schedule.text: Scheduled volunteer days in 2026, announced by email and on Eventbrite; solo cleanups any time

first_step.how: Register for a volunteer day on Eventbrite and sign the digital waiver at riverfrontnorth.org/waiver
first_step.basis: Anyone can take part, but each volunteer day needs a registration and a signed waiver

records.notes: Status is active because the site refers to 2026 volunteer opportunities and 2026 business Trailblazers, but no dated event with a month was shown, so no last_sign_of_life is recorded. The Trailblazer page also lists a park opening in July 2025. Anyone under 14 must be with a guardian over 18. The Meetup volunteer group for this org was seen only as a lead and was not used as a source. Credit: Meetup volunteering topic page.

records.name: Philly Knits
records.summary: A free fiber arts group for knitters, crocheters, weavers and sewers at every skill level. Members meet at various places around the city and online, and the group posts volunteer requests from local charities.
records.what_you_do: Come to a Sit and Stitch, make items for a local charity, or start a meetup in your own neighborhood.

schedule.text: Meets at various locations and online, with dates posted on its meetup listings; no fixed weekly time on its site

locations.label: Various locations in Philadelphia, and online

first_step.how: Go to a Sit and Stitch, or email the founder to ask how to join
first_step.basis: The site says all skill levels are welcome and gives a contact for joining

records.notes: The site says it is looking for a new meetup organizer, so confirm the group is still running before sending people. The site's own list of other fiber groups says it may be out of date. Its main meetup listing is on Meetup, which was used only as a lead. The site also publishes a phone number, not copied here. Founder: Lynn Landes.

records.name: Liberty Bell Knitting Guild
records.summary: A knitting and crochet guild that meets in Northeast Philadelphia. Members also quilt, embroider, needlepoint and sew, and many make items for local charities.
records.what_you_do: Bring a current project, share it at the round of introductions, and ask questions afterward.

schedule.text: Second Saturday of each month at 11 am

first_step.how: Come to a second Saturday meeting; the site says all are welcome and guests are welcome
first_step.basis: The site says all are welcome and that each meeting starts with introductions, so a newcomer knows what to expect

records.notes: The site works, but no dated event appears in its text. Its events are in an embedded calendar that did not load, so no dates were checked. The site did not publish a contact email. Cost and dues are not stated.

records.name: Fibercraft Group at Ryerss Museum and Library
records.summary: Free fiber arts afternoons at the Ryerss Museum and Library in Northeast Philadelphia, open to the public on the museum's listed dates. The museum page does not say what each session covers.
records.what_you_do: Attend a listed afternoon. Call the museum to ask what to bring, since the page does not say.

schedule.text: Fridays and Sundays, 1 to 3 pm, on listed dates in July and August 2026

cost.text: Free and open to the public; donations welcome

first_step.how: Come on a listed date. The page gives no sign-up process.
first_step.basis: Open to the public with no sign-up described, but the page does not say what a newcomer does there

records.notes: The page lists only the July and August 2026 dates, which have now passed. Confirm the next dates by phone before sending people. The museum page calls it the Fibercraft Group. Its Facebook page is the museum's other listed place for updates.

records.name: Philadelphia Guild of Handweavers and Fiber Artists
records.summary: A fiber arts center in Manayunk that offers workshops and education, plus special interest groups where members learn weaving and other fiber techniques together.
records.what_you_do: Join the guild, then take part in a workshop or a special interest group meeting.

schedule.text: Special interest groups and workshops, with dates on the guild calendar; the site did not show dates in the text

first_step.how: Register through the guild's registration page
first_step.basis: Joining is by membership registration, and the site does not state a visitor policy

records.notes: The site did not show the times of its special interest groups. A fiber group list on another site gives a Tuesday morning portable fibers time, but that was not verified here, so it is not recorded. The 2026 fall date comes from a file name on the site, not a dated event. The email was decoded from the page; confirm before relying on it. Membership cost not stated.

records.name: Philadelphia Drunken Knitwits
records.summary: A group of knitters and crocheters who meet weekly on Wednesday evenings in bars and restaurants around central Philadelphia. The Philadelphia chapter has met since 2017.
records.what_you_do: Bring a project, knit or crochet at the table, and talk with the group.

schedule.text: Weekly on Wednesday evenings at a rotating bar or restaurant in Center City or University City; 21 and over

locations.label: Rotating bars and restaurants, Center City or University City

records.notes: The 2025 news story and a fiber group list both describe weekly Wednesday meetings. Neither confirms the group still meets. The group's only contact found is a Meetup page, which was used as a lead only, so no contact is recorded. The venue rotates, so the group list may be out of date. The joining process is not published on a non-platform page, so no first step is recorded.

records.name: Tacony LAB Community Art Center
records.summary: A community art center in Tacony run by Mural Arts Philadelphia with a city council office. It offers free art classes for adults and youth, open studio time, and a Saturday kids club.
records.what_you_do: Take a free painting, drawing, sewing, weaving or laser cutter class, or use the open studio.

schedule.text: Open studio for 30 plus hours a week; free classes with no dates listed; Saturday kids club held three weekends a month

cost.text: Free art classes and free arts events

first_step.how: Visit the open studio, or sign up for the Saturday kids club through Eventbrite
first_step.basis: Free classes, open studio hours and a listed sign up route give a newcomer a clear start

records.notes: The site lists classes and hours without specific dates, and no upcoming events appear, so status is probably active on a working site. Its copyright year is not used as evidence. Founded in 2017 per the site. Membership cost is not listed. Contact email is not published; the page links to a Contact Us page.

notes: Platform use: 11 of 12 Meetup pages used (meditation, drawing, improv, choir, knitting, dance, jam sessions, parents, volunteering, sketching, music). Several topic pages (drawing, sketching, choir, dance, jam sessions, parents) returned only a skip link with no listings, so their groups were not seen and no bot check or 403 was recorded. No login was attempted. Join Philly was not used. Searches: all 8 used, so many Meetup groups could not be followed to their own sites; the budget ran out before more could be checked. Brahma Kumaris: one search found no Philadelphia center (nearest listed is Pittsburgh), so it was not recorded. Out of area Meetup groups seen but not recorded: several South Jersey knitting and craft groups, Montgomery County, several New York and New Jersey meditation and music groups, and Suburban Philly Adventures. Status calls: four records are active or probably active on dated or working-site evidence; Code for Philly is unknown; the Philadelphia Drunken Knitwits record rests on a March 2025 news story only.
